api.normalization: Divide raw info.position by1000 to supply positionSeconds; preserve original values and received order.

decisionMeaning.persistent_ai_indicators: A valid persistent run exists; any additional isolated alerts stay unresolved and reviewRequired remains true.
decisionMeaning.inconclusive: Isolated positives without a persistent run, or technical/coverage failure. Technical failure must be reported separately and fails advancement.
decisionMeaning.no_clear_indicators: No positive samples with complete coverage. Not proof of real origin or exclusion of AI between samples.

scope: Narrow uncalibrated development rejection screen. No subsecond, new mixed-positive, population or independent validation claim.
